blocks.text: за- — doing the action of the base word in advance, or to store

«совершить заранее или впрок действие, названное производящим словом» is how the Russian Wiktionary puts this meaning of за-. Its examples: заготовить, замариновать, запланировать, запроектировать, засолить.

head: Word
Made of (Wiktionary's etymology)
Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: to store up, to lay in (stock); to prepare

blocks.text: (used with verbs) in advance (describing an action of doing something ahead of time) — за- + гото́вить (“to prepare”) → загото́вить (“to prepare”)

head: Word
Made of (Wiktionary's etymology)
Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: to store up, to lay in (stock); to prepare

blocks.text: пред- — an action carried out in advance
«действия, осуществлённого заранее» is how the Russian Wiktionary puts this meaning of пред-. Its examples: преднамеренный, преднамеренно, предвзятый, предупредить.

head: Word
Made of (Wiktionary's etymology)
Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: to warn, to let know beforehand; to forestall, to anticipate

blocks.text: (used with verbs) before, fore-, pre- — пред- + писа́ть (“to write”) → предписа́ть (“to prescribe”); пред- + ви́деть (“to see”) → предви́деть (“to foresee”); пред- + расположи́ть (“to dispose, to arrange”) → предрасположи́ть (“to predispose”)

head: Word
Made of (Wiktionary's etymology)
Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: to prescribe; to direct, to order
to foresee, to foreknow, to see coming
